name: Ludo.ai
tagline: AI game ideation, market research, and asset generation.
description: Ludo.ai began as the first dedicated AI game-ideation tool — generating game concepts, surfacing market and trend research, and helping developers validate ideas. It has since broadened into asset generation (sprites and spritesheets, 2D/3D models, audio, and video) alongside its ideation and market-analysis features. Access is via a web app, REST API, an MCP integration, and a Unity Editor plugin.
insight: Founded in 2020 by Tom Pigott and billed as the first dedicated AI game-ideation tool, predating the generative-asset wave.
edge: Pairs idea generation with live market and trend research — a 'what should I build' co-pilot most asset tools lack.

references.title: Ludo: AI-Powered Toolkit Helping Developers Create Games
